title: abies marocana subsp. tazaotana
intro: Abies marocana subsp. tazaotana, commonly known as Atlas Cedar, is a coniferous plant species native to the Atlas Mountains in Morocco. Research suggests that the Atlas Cedar has several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can aid in the treatment of various ailments. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as sesquiterpenes, phenolic compounds, and essential oils, which exert anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant effects. Additionally, the bioactive constituents of the Atlas Cedar, including alpha-pinene, beta-pinene, and limonene, contribute to its therapeutic properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
